definitions.short: to be violent ; by implication, to maltreat
definitions.usage: make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully.
definitions.full: H2554. chamas [ חָמַס ] verb treat violently, wrong (Late Hebrew id. , act violently, treat violently ; Aramaic חֲמַס (rare) violently seize ; Arabic is be hard, strict, rigorous ) — Qal Perfect 3plural חָֽמְסוּ Ezek 22:26 ; Zeph 3:4 ; Imperfect יַחְמֹס Job 15:33 , וַיַּחְמֹס Lam 2:6 ; תַּחְמֹ֑סוּ Job 21:27 ; Jer 22:3 ; Participle חֹמֵס Prov 8:36 ; — treat violently, wrong ; — 1 of physical wrong : ׳תַּחְ Jer 22:3 (|| תֹּנוּ ) of wrong to widows and orphans; ׳וַיַּח שֻׂכּוֺ כַּגַּן Lam 2:6 and hath done violence to his pavilion as to a garden (|| מֹעֲדוֺ שִׁחֵת ); so, figurative, of vine, wrong , i.e. fail to nourish, kill בִּסְרוֺ ׳יַח כַּגֶּפֶן Job 15:33 . 2 of ethical wrong , object תּוֺרָה Zeph 3:4 ; Exod 22:26 (both || קֹדֶשׁ חִלֵּל ); compare תַּחְמֹ֑סוּ עָלֵי מְזִמּוֺת Job 21:27 the devices (wherewith) ye do me violence. 3 both physical and ethical נַפְשׁוֺ חֹמֵס חֹטְאִי Prov 8:36 . Niph`al Perfect 3plural נֶחְמְסוּ Jer 13:22 thy heels suffer violence (|| שׁוּלַיִךְ נִגְלוּ ).

occurrences.englishText: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine,
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul.
If you say in your heart,

Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.
He has violently taken away his tabernacle,

Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.
Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
